evidence_required: the protocol with every control and the decision rule; manifest fields.

marking.criterion: Warm-up (-w) and measured iterations (-n) stated; ≥ 6 separate launches per version
Arms interleaved; concurrency controlled (dedicated nodes, nothing else running)
Input sizes swept (e.g. 8 B to 8 GiB, factor 2); only the NCCL version varies, identical topology (mapping CSV golden) and environment
Noise floor from an A/A comparison (same version twice)
Pre-registered decision rule: median busbw per size per launch, bootstrap CI over launches, practical threshold
Manifest fields: NCCL, driver, CUDA, NIC firmware, OFED/DOCA, topology, env vars, sizes, iteration counts

title: Benchmark protocol for two NCCL versions
